import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
def fetch(u):
    r=requests.get(u,timeout=150,headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}); r.raise_for_status(); return r.text
T3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def parse_pdb(txt,model1=True,chains=None):
    out=[]
    for l in txt.splitlines():
        if model1 and l.startswith('ENDMDL'): break
        if l.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")):
            if l[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
            if chains and l[21] not in chains: continue
            try: out.append(dict(name=l[12:16].strip(),resn=l[17:20].strip(),ch=l[21],resi=int(l[22:26]),
                 xyz=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])]),
                 el=(l[76:78].strip() or l[12:16].strip()[0])))
            except ValueError: pass
    return out
def A(st,ch,r,n):
    for a in st:
        if a['ch']==ch and a['resi']==r and a['name']==n: return a['xyz']
def kabsch(P,Q):
    Pc,Qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0); H=(P-Pc).T@(Q-Qc); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    D=np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))]); R=Vt.T@D@U.T; return R,Qc-R@Pc
def app(R,t,X): return (R@np.asarray(X).T).T+t

AF=parse_pdb(fetch("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q8WW27-F1-model_v6.pdb"))
A3A=parse_pdb(fetch("https://files.rcsb.org/download/5SWW.pdb"))
sa4=[(93,'ND1'),(93,'CG'),(93,'CB'),(93,'CA'),(127,'SG'),(127,'CB'),(127,'CA'),(134,'SG'),(134,'CB'),(134,'CA')]
sa3=[(70,'ND1'),(70,'CG'),(70,'CB'),(70,'CA'),(101,'SG'),(101,'CB'),(101,'CA'),(106,'SG'),(106,'CB'),(106,'CA')]
R,t=kabsch(np.array([A(A3A,'A',r,n) for r,n in sa3]), np.array([A(AF,'A',r,n) for r,n in sa4]))
dnaA=[a for a in A3A if a['ch']=='E' and a['resn'] in ('DA','DT','DG','DC')]
dnaT=app(R,t,[a['xyz'] for a in dnaA])

prot4=np.array([a['xyz'] for a in AF if 55<=a['resi']<=215])
prot3=np.array([a['xyz'] for a in A3A if a['ch']=='A' and a['resn']!='ZN'])
dm4=np.linalg.norm(dnaT[:,None,:]-prot4[None,:,:],axis=2).min(1)
dm3=np.linalg.norm(np.array([a['xyz'] for a in dnaA])[:,None,:]-prot3[None,:,:],axis=2).min(1)
print("Transplanted ssDNA, min distance to protein heavy atom:")
print(f"  in APOBEC3A (native complex): median {np.median(dm3):.2f} A, atoms <2.8 A = {(dm3<2.8).sum()}/{len(dm3)}")
print(f"  in APOBEC4 (AF model)       : median {np.median(dm4):.2f} A, atoms <2.8 A = {(dm4<2.8).sum()}/{len(dm4)}")

# surface charge of the putative ssDNA channel (residues with any atom within 14 A of modelled Zn)
znT=app(R,t,[[a['xyz'] for a in A3A if a['resn']=='ZN' and a['ch']=='A'][0]])[0]
zn3=[a['xyz'] for a in A3A if a['resn']=='ZN' and a['ch']=='A'][0]
def netcharge(st,ch,zn,rad=14.0,lo=None,hi=None):
    seen={}
    for a in st:
        if a['ch']!=ch or a['resn'] in ('ZN','HOH'): continue
        if lo and not (lo<=a['resi']<=hi): continue
        if np.linalg.norm(a['xyz']-zn)<rad: seen[a['resi']]=T3.get(a['resn'],'X')
    pos=sum(1 for v in seen.values() if v in 'KR'); neg=sum(1 for v in seen.values() if v in 'DE')
    return len(seen),pos,neg,pos-neg
print("\nCharge of residues lining the catalytic cleft (any atom within 14 A of the Zn):")
for lab,(n,p,q,net) in {'APOBEC4 (AF, res 55-215)':netcharge(AF,'A',znT,lo=55,hi=215),
                        'APOBEC3A 5SWW':netcharge(A3A,'A',zn3)}.items():
    print(f"  {lab:<26} n={n:3d}  Lys+Arg={p:2d}  Asp+Glu={q:2d}  net={net:+d}")

# ---------------- FIGURE ----------------
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(13,9))
ax=axes[0,0]
zn_tbl=pd.DataFrame([
 ('APOBEC3A 4XXO',3.80,3.39,4.03,'active'),('APOBEC3A 5KEG',3.69,3.44,3.66,'active'),
 ('APOBEC3A 5SWW',3.12,3.55,3.90,'active'),('APOBEC3G 3IR2',3.56,3.59,3.85,'active'),
 ('APOBEC3G 6P3X',3.78,3.73,3.60,'active'),('AID 5W0R',3.64,3.58,3.89,'active'),
 ('APOBEC1 6X91',4.33,4.19,3.18,'active'),('APOBEC2 2NYT',3.89,3.56,3.61,'inactive paralog'),
 ('APOBEC4 AF C127/C134',3.33,3.80,3.80,'APOBEC4 model'),
 ('APOBEC4 AF C127/C133',3.33,9.62,7.67,'APOBEC4 model (wrong Cys)')],
 columns=['s','His-SG1','His-SG2','SG-SG','grp'])
x=np.arange(len(zn_tbl)); w=0.27
col={'active':'#4C72B0','inactive paralog':'#937860','APOBEC4 model':'#C44E52','APOBEC4 model (wrong Cys)':'#CCCCCC'}
for k,c in enumerate(['His-SG1','His-SG2','SG-SG']):
    ax.bar(x+(k-1)*w, zn_tbl[c], w, label=c, color=[col[g] for g in zn_tbl.grp], alpha=[0.55,0.8,1.0][k], edgecolor='k',linewidth=.4)
ax.axhspan(3.1,4.4,color='green',alpha=.08)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(zn_tbl.s,rotation=55,ha='right',fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_ylabel('ligand-ligand distance (A)'); ax.set_title('Zinc-ligand geometry: APOBEC4 model vs active deaminases\n(green band = experimental range of active sites)',fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylim(0,10)

ax=axes[0,1]
acc=pd.DataFrame([('APOBEC3A apo 4XXO',0.092,'active'),('APOBEC3A+ssDNA 5SWW',0.042,'active'),
                  ('APOBEC3G-CTD 3IR2',0.015,'active'),('APOBEC4 AF model',0.005,'APOBEC4'),
                  ('APOBEC2 2NYT',0.000,'inactive')],columns=['s','v','g'])
ax.barh(acc.s, acc.v, color=[{'active':'#4C72B0','APOBEC4':'#C44E52','inactive':'#937860'}[g] for g in acc.g], edgecolor='k',linewidth=.4)
ax.set_xlabel('probe-accessible fraction of the catalytic Zn'); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_title('Active-site cleft openness (1.4 A probe)',fontsize=10)

ax=axes[1,0]
ax.hist(dm3,bins=np.arange(0,10,0.4),alpha=.65,label='APOBEC3A, native ssDNA complex',color='#4C72B0')
ax.hist(dm4,bins=np.arange(0,10,0.4),alpha=.65,label='same ssDNA placed on APOBEC4 model',color='#C44E52')
ax.axvline(2.8,ls='--',c='k'); ax.set_xlabel('ssDNA atom to nearest protein heavy atom (A)')
ax.set_ylabel('ssDNA atoms'); ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.set_title('Substrate channel is occluded in the APOBEC4 model',fontsize=10)

ax=axes[1,1]
cd=pd.DataFrame([('H93 Zn ligand',99.1),('E95 catalytic Glu',98.2),('P126 of PCxxC',99.1),('C127 Zn ligand',98.7),
                 ('C134 Zn ligand',98.7),('H132',95.6),('H65 cleft-blocking',94.2),('Y158 ~A3A Y130',93.4),
                 ('H159 ~A3A D131',88.5),('C133 non-ligand',85.0),('Q62 loop1',80.5),('P61 loop1',53.5),
                 ('T63 ~A3A H29',38.9),('N124 ~A3A W98',31.0),('Y91 loop3',5.3),('V185 background',4.0)],
                columns=['pos','pct'])
cd=cd.sort_values('pct')
ax.barh(cd.pos,cd.pct,color=['#C44E52' if p>90 else '#4C72B0' if p>60 else '#AAAAAA' for p in cd.pct],edgecolor='k',linewidth=.4)
ax.axvline(45,ls='--',c='k'); ax.text(46,0.2,'median whole-protein identity (45%)',fontsize=7)
ax.set_xlabel('% identical to human in 226 vertebrate APOBEC4 orthologs')
ax.set_title('Catalytic constellation is near-invariant across tetrapods',fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
